about: Twin Cities west/northwest/north-east (Plymouth, Maple Grove, Roseville area) research for Veterans Day 2026, compiled 9 Nov 2026. Items here are not routable local stops on Wed 11 Nov, or are outside the area.

other.name: 5-8 Club: free burger for veterans
other.where: Maplewood and Champlin stores (just outside the area; addresses not checked)
other.offer: Free burger (classic or Juicy Lucy) with choice of fries, carrot sticks or coleslaw for veterans.
other.note: A 6 Nov 2026 list (Bring Me The News) names the Champlin, Maplewood, Minneapolis and West St. Paul stores. Call yours first.

other.name: Tria Restaurant: free meal
other.where: 5959 Centerville Rd, North Oaks (just outside the area, north of Shoreview)
other.offer: Free meal from a limited menu for veterans and active-duty personnel.
other.note: From a 6 Nov 2026 list; call to confirm.

other.name: Kendall's Tavern and Chophouse: free meal
other.where: 12800 Bunker Prairie Rd NW, Coon Rapids (outside the area, north of Brooklyn Park)
other.offer: Free meal from a limited menu for veterans and active-duty personnel.
other.note: From a 6 Nov 2026 list; call to confirm.

other.name: Official State of Minnesota Veterans Day celebration
other.where: Duluth National Guard Training and Community Center, Duluth
other.offer: Free community breakfast from 8:30, program at 10:00: honor guard, live music, keynote, elected officials.
other.note: Outside the area (about 150 miles). One source (Bring Me The News, 8 Nov 2026); the Minnesota Department of Veterans Affairs events page was empty when checked. The 2025 state event was in Mankato.

other.name: Metro Transit: free fare for service-connected disabled veterans
other.offer: Veterans with a service-related disability ride free at all times with a VA Veteran ID card marked 'Service Connected' or 'SC' below the photo. No general free rides for all veterans on Veterans Day found.
other.note: Questions: 612-467-1991 (per the fares page). Metro Transit runs its regular holiday schedule on 11 Nov per BMTN.

other.day: All of November (parking free on Wed 11 Nov)
other.name: Minnesota Zoo: free admission for veterans and active military
other.offer: Free admission for veterans and active military through 30 Nov; up to six immediate family members 50% off. Parking not included, free parking extended 11 Nov per one list.
other.note: Outside the area (about 40 miles south). Two 2026 lists carry it; the zoo's own page didn't show the offer when checked. Bring military ID and confirm.

other.name: Museum of Illusions: free admission for veterans
other.offer: Free admission for active and retired US veterans 11-17 Nov with valid military ID in person.
other.note: Outside the area. Single 2026 list (Twin Cities Frugal Mom, 6 Nov 2026).

other.name: Free Geek Twin Cities: 20% veteran discount
other.note: Address and terms not given in the source.

other.name: Science Museum of Minnesota: free general admission for veterans and active duty
other.where: Science Museum of Minnesota, St. Paul
other.offer: Complimentary general admission with military ID.
other.note: One undated deal-list page only; no museum announcement found. Call first.

other.name: National parks and other federal lands: fee-free day
other.where: Federal lands nationwide, including Minnesota units
other.offer: No entrance fee on 11 Nov at National Park Service sites for US citizens and residents (from 2026, nonresidents pay the regular fee).
other.note: Federal lands only, not Minnesota state parks. From a 2026 local deal list; check nps.gov.

other.name: Minnesota state parks: no free day on Veterans Day
other.offer: The DNR's only listed free entrance day in the fall is Fri 27 Nov 2026. Nothing for 11 Nov.
other.note: The DNR's page lists Fri 27 Nov 2026 and nothing for 11 Nov. Veteran and military vehicle-permit rules are on a separate DNR page.

leads.name: Minnesota Military & Veterans Museum Veterans Day Film Festival
leads.area: Little Falls, Stillwater, Mankato (not the metro west/north)
leads.q: Minnesota Military and Veterans Museum Veterans Day Film Festival
leads.offer: Free film screenings after local ceremonies (2025: Little Falls 1 pm, Stillwater 11:30, Mankato 11:30).

leads.name: Osseo-Maple Grove American Legion Post 172
leads.q: American Legion Post 172 260 4th Ave SE Osseo MN
leads.offer: Post runs the Central Park ceremony with Beyond the Yellow Ribbon (see Wed 11 Nov entry); no separate post meal found for 2026.
